display_long_description:
# "Just One More Set!"

Ever had that "just one more game" urge — for your workout?
Punch, slash, shoot to the beat. You'll be hitting play on the next track in no time.

Forget willpower.
Step into 'Calorie Hunters' — the most enjoyable healthy addiction in VR rhythm action.

⠀

# 🌟 Where Fun Meets Real Fitness
⠀
# 1. ⚔️ Hunt the Calories, Not the Chore!
- Calories appear as Monsters — real prey, not abstract numbers.
- Every punch, squat, slash, and shot lands a powerful blow.
- Clear a round and climb the Global Leaderboards against Hunters worldwide

⠀
# 2. 🤯 Never Boring, Always Fresh!
- All VR rhythm action fun — punch, slash, shoot, smash — in one session.
- Our algorithm mixes weapons and notes randomly every time. No two routines alike.
- Workout burnout? Not anymore

⠀
# 3. 🆕 NEW in This Update!
- 🐉 **Boss Battles** — A true challenger for Hunters who've outgrown ordinary prey. The Boss summons Rhythm Monsters — hunt them down to strike the Boss itself. Defeat it and claim your bounty.
- 🤝 **Supporter System** — Spend the Gold you earn hunting to build your own Supporter dance team. They'll cheer you on with adorable dance moves while your allies bring unique abilities and grow stronger with every rank-up. Who you hunt with is your new strategy.

⠀
# 4. 🗺️ What's Coming Next
'Calorie Hunters' grows with its players. This is just the beginning.
- New themed stages added regularly.
- Multiplayer and more co-op content on the way.
- A deeper, richer 'one more set' is always waiting for you.
